subject: Course-page wording
body:
Copy review questions for Jule

The headline in Karim's layout isn't the one in the copy sheet. Sara needs a rough line count before requesting the next leaflet quote. Neither issue can be solved by exporting another PDF called final.

Dina has proposed practice-based examples under the learning outcomes. Please discuss those beside the headline so we don't approve a paragraph while everybody imagines a different title above it.

The draft price badge was a spacing test, not a new offer. I've asked for it to be removed from this review. Use the registration figures for pricing discussions. Ines
title: Course-page wording
